profile.name: Quinn Yang
profile.summary: I’m an architecture student at NTUST, originally from Myanmar. I enjoy designing spaces that bring people together — from youth hostels and campus buildings to places of worship and museums — and I build my projects in Revit and visualise them with Lumion.

projects.title: Zhongshan International Youth Hostel
projects.meta: Zhongshan District, Taipei · Youth hostel · 6 floors + basement

sections.heading: Concept — Holding Hands
sections.text: Two hands clasped together: one person needs both hands to be strong, and a group is stronger still. The handshake shapes the building’s exterior. Inside, guests can rest on their own or share space with friends — a place that offers great service, a pleasant environment and the togetherness a group needs.

sections.heading: Site & Design
sections.text: Located on Lane 46, Zhongshan N. Rd. Sec. 2 — a 4–6 minute walk from Zhongshan and Shuanglian MRT stations, surrounded by shopping, hotels, salons and food streets with a young crowd. Curtain-wall glazing brings in ventilation and daylight, and planted terraces on every level give the building warmth.

projects.title: Glory Building — NTUST Digital Construction Center
projects.titleZh: 光榮大樓 台科大數位構築中心
projects.meta: NTUST Hsinchu Campus (~70,000 m²) · Education & research

sections.heading: Concept — The Graduation Cap
sections.text: The design is inspired by a graduation cap. The glazed cylindrical core — the “crown” of the cap — is the daylit heart of the building, while the two wings on either side hold teaching and research spaces.

sections.heading: Programme
sections.text: Lobby, administration, R&D studios, workshops, equipment and material storage, discussion rooms, undergraduate studios, a photography area, library and multi-purpose rooms — organised around campus pedestrian routes and plazas.

gallery.alt: Aerial site view of Glory Building

projects.title: Dawn Light Church — Religious Architecture in the City
projects.titleZh: 曦光教堂 · 都市中的宗教建築
projects.meta: Aiguo W. Rd. & Guangzhou St., Taipei · Christian · Modern style

sections.heading: Concept — Light
sections.text: The design celebrates morning light, sunlight and the everyday changes of light. When people are under pressure or walking through darkness, a church should be the first place they think of — a pure, bright place.

sections.heading: A Place of Warmth
sections.text: Whatever burdens you carry, coming to the church should bring a warm and happy moment, and anyone can come here to help those in need — giving them a bright home. A central courtyard ties together classrooms, an auditorium and the main sanctuary.

projects.title: 3D Interactive — Anping Fishery & Fish Exhibition Hall
projects.titleZh: 3D互動 – 安平漁與魚展覽館 · 溯源地域 融合未來
projects.meta: East side of Anping Harbour, Tainan · Museum

sections.heading: Concept — Water
sections.text: Anping Harbour cannot be separated from water — its fishery and its fish live in and on the water — so the building’s form is drawn from the shapes of waves.

sections.heading: Façade & Light
sections.text: The spheres on the façade represent crystal water droplets; light filters through the gaps between them into the interior. Reflecting pools around the base make the building appear to float on water. Inside: a 3D interactive fish zone, exhibitions, an indoor water-curtain pool and a seafood restaurant.
